name: Aya-nee no Kyouikuteki☆Shidou!
original_name: あやねぇの教育的☆姉導!
source:
Main character has a good female childhood friend who is already an adult, but both of them are afraid to ruin their friendship and take a step further. But they are conscious of mutual romantic feelings, and day X eventually comes...
